exported_functions.name: byteVC2_get_next_access_unit
exported_functions.proof: Scans start code 0x000001, parses NAL unit type (byte >> 3) & 0x1f, verifies AUD/IRAP/non-IRAP frame boundaries matching opcode 0x0000da98

exported_functions.name: byteVC2_set_log_callback
exported_functions.proof: Stores log callback at 0x80d48, user opaque pointer at 0x80d50, severity level at 0x80000

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_get_version
exported_functions.proof: Writes 64-bit constant 0x00332e312e382e30ULL directly into output buffer representing '0.8.1.3\0'

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_alloc_packet
exported_functions.proof: Calls malloc with size 0x38 (56 bytes) for ByteVC2Packet struct

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_release_packet
exported_functions.proof: Frees ByteVC2Packet structure

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_set_packet_integer_info
exported_functions.proof: Binary search strncmp matching bs_len (0x04), flag (0x00), drop_frame (0x10), pts (0x18), opt (0x20), simp (0x28), wait_frame (0x30)

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_set_packet_float_info
exported_functions.proof: Parses 'drop_rate' via strncmp, converts float and writes to packet offset 0x14

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_set_packet_pointer_info
exported_functions.proof: Parses 'bs' via strncmp, writes uint8_t* pointer to packet offset 0x08

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_alloc_frame
exported_functions.proof: Allocates 0x90 (144 bytes) frame struct, allocates 0xe0 (224 bytes) internal info at offset 0x88, initializes bit_depth=8 at offset 0x68

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_release_frame
exported_functions.proof: Releases planar YUV buffers, frees internal 224-byte info at 0x88, frees 144-byte frame container

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_get_frame_integer_info
exported_functions.proof: Evaluates stride (0x24+plane*4), linesize (0x30+plane*4), width (0x00), height (0x04), pts (0x08), opt (0x10), simp (0x18), bit_depth (0x68), color flags (0x69..0x6d), key_frame (0x6e), pix_fmt (0x70), got_frame (0x74), poc (0x78)

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_get_frame_float_info
exported_functions.proof: Returns 0.0f via fmov d0, xzr

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_get_frame_pointer_info
exported_functions.proof: Returns plane buffer pointers data[plane] at 0x40+plane*8 and AHardwareBuffer* at offset 0x60

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_get_default_param
exported_functions.proof: Allocates 0x2c (44 bytes) ByteVC2Param struct, initializes default vector values from .rodata 0x73730 and sets parallel_frames=8, hardware_buffer=0

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_release_param
exported_functions.proof: Frees ByteVC2Param struct

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_print_param
exported_functions.proof: Logs formatted BVC2 decoder param string with all 10 integer configuration fields

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_set_param_integer_info
exported_functions.proof: Parses max_pic_width (0x00), max_pic_height (0x04), max_parallel_frames (0x08), threads (0x0c), output_time (0x10), output_method (0x14), md5_check (0x18), wpp_mode (0x1c), parallel_frames (0x20), advanced_simd (0x24), hardware_buffer (0x28)

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_set_param_float_info
exported_functions.proof: Returns -1 (unsupported)

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_set_param_pointer_info
exported_functions.proof: Returns -1 (unsupported)

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_create
exported_functions.proof: Allocates 0x7b8 (1976 bytes) context, enforces threads >= 1, initializes DPB, logs 'BVC2 decoder (V%s) is created!'

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_destroy
exported_functions.proof: Frees all pictures in DPB, releases packet queue, frees 1976-byte context

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_reconfig
exported_functions.proof: Applies new ByteVC2Param configuration, logs 'BVC2 decoder (V%s) reconfig'

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_flush
exported_functions.proof: Sets state to FLUSHING, drains DPB picture queue, marks remaining pictures ready for display

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_send_packet
exported_functions.proof: Queues bitstream packet for asynchronous decoding

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_decode
exported_functions.proof: Decodes bitstream packet, reconstructs planar YUV pixels, assigns POC, inserts into DPB, returns frame

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_get_frame
exported_functions.proof: Extracts frame with lowest un-outputted POC from DPB, copies metadata and plane pointers

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_return_frame
exported_functions.proof: Decrements DPB reference counter, recycles buffer into frame pool when no longer referenced

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_dump_video_info
exported_functions.proof: Formats video resolution, bit depth, pixel format, thread count

exported_functions.name: byteVC2dec_dump_decoding_status
exported_functions.proof: Formats decoded frame count, dropped frame count, DPB usage metrics
